text: SIM Swap Fraud and Phishing Incident Response Document ID: SOP_C18_FRAUD_RESPONSE Category: C18 — Security & Fraud Department: Security Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Purpose To enable rapid containment of suspected SIM swap fraud, phishing, or account takeover attempts. Scope Applies to all channels and customer segments unless a specific exception is noted below. Preconditions Customer identity verified (registered number and OTP where applicable). Account is active and not under a fraud, legal, or compliance hold. Roles & Responsibilities Required Information Registered mobile number / account ID. Nature of the request and any reference numbers already issued. Relevant transaction or ticket ID, where applicable. Procedure Verify caller identity via an independent channel (not the potentially compromised number). Block the affected SIM immediately if fraud indicators are present, even before full verification completes, if risk is imminent. Log the case as a P1 security incident. Issue a verified replacement SIM only after standard KYC re-verification. Notify the Security and Legal teams for cases involving confirmed financial loss for potential law-enforcement liaison. Decision Points If the request qualifies under standard criteria, proceed with automatic processing. If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP. Exception Handling Cases outside standard scope require supervisor sign-off before proceeding. Validation Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and obtain customer confirmation where applicable. Escalation Escalations beyond first-line resolution are logged with
